inputs: the admission result and the agent's plan only (no oracle, no scenario metadata, no repository notes)

signals.S1: the plan declares a decision of a consequential type (exception, override, conflict-resolution, default-rule, scope-extension)
signals.S2: admission rejected at least one planned decision
signals.S3: the plan cites a granted approval (an approval is a bounded grant; extension beyond it is the F7 risk)
signals.S4: a planned decision declares scopeImpact `extends` or `unknown`

tier: high if any signal fires, otherwise low
high: independent review of the plan before implementation (prevention) and of the change at the gate (detection), each one K1 reviewer call; blocking gate findings return the work for one repair turn
low: as arm D: admission and the gate only
